summary_1line: Suka attains complete detachment, ascends through the cosmos, and dissolves into attribute-less Brahman amid cosmic wonders and universal reverence.

image_candidates.scene_text: Suka, radiant like the sun, flies through the sky while gods, rishis, and celestial beings shower flowers from heaven.
The ascetic Suka crashes through two colossal mountain summits—one golden, one silver—splitting them apart as he continues northward through the sky.
As Suka merges into the attribute-less Brahman, meteors streak across the sky, the earth trembles, and the directions blaze with uncanny light.
